featured_reviews.name: Nikhil Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited the Virar West Post Office and was quite disappointed with the service. The overall speed of the staff is extremely slow, and many employees seem to lack a sense of responsibility toward their work.

A recent incident left me particularly frustrated. A female staff member was handling my parcel, but since she was new, she was taking a bit more time to process it. Just as she was completing the task, the working hours came to an end. Instead of assisting her or ensuring my work was completed, a male staff member simply stated, "Abhi time ho gaya, ab hum kaam nahi karenge" (It's time now, we won’t work anymore).

This kind of attitude is unacceptable, especially in a service that people rely on for important postal work. The post office staff should be more professional, responsible, and committed to assisting customers rather than strictly adhering to time limits without concern for pending work.

I hope the authorities take steps to improve the efficiency and customer service at this post office.

featured_reviews.name: Naval Nagar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I used India Post's Speed Post service to send an important parcel, but it has been 9 days, and the parcel has still not been delivered. I have lodged multiple complaints through various channels, including the post office website, Twitter, and emails, but I have yet to receive a single response.

This experience has been extremely frustrating. The lack of communication and accountability from the postal department is disappointing. I would strongly advise against using India Post for any important or time-sensitive deliveries. Even using a private courier service would be a better option.

It’s no surprise that private sector services are growing in India. People, like myself, are increasingly frustrated with the poor service and lack of reliability from government-run services like India Post. The convenience, efficiency, and customer service offered by private companies are far superior.

If you value your time and peace of mind, avoid using India Post's services.
